definition.simple: An atom or group of atoms that has an electrical charge because it lost or gained electrons.
definition.academic: A charged particle formed when an atom or a group of atoms loses or gains one or more electrons.

common_misconceptions: Atoms and ions are the same. (Correction: Atoms are neutral, ions have an electrical charge.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: A positive ion (cation) has LOST an electron (lost negativity). A negative ion (anion) has GAINED an electron (gained negativity).
